units.source_text: 那笑容看似輕蔑，似乎又不太像，若把人世間比作大海，一種詭異之影搖曳在萬丈深淵的海底。

en.t: The smile seemed contemptuous, yet not quite; if the world of human beings were compared to the sea, a strange shadow swayed on the seabed of an unfathomable abyss.

units.source_text: 那種笑容，讓我隱約窺見了成年人生活中最深層的奧祕。

en.t: That kind of smile gave me a faint glimpse of the deepest secret at the heart of adult life.

units.source_text: 「你這樣想的話，我們就沒什麼好談的了。

en.t: If that is how you think, then there is nothing more for us to discuss.

units.source_text: 你的想法太不切合實際。

en.t: Your thinking is far too unrealistic.

units.source_text: 你再好好想想吧，今晚請認真考慮一下。」

en.t: Think it over carefully again, and please consider it seriously tonight.

units.source_text: 被他這麼一說，我就像被追跑似的爬上二樓，躺在床上，翻來覆去地還是沒想出什麼好主意。

en.t: After he said that, I climbed to the second floor as if I were being chased, lay down on the bed, and tossed and turned without coming up with any good idea.

units.source_text: 天亮時，我逃出了比目魚的家。

en.t: At daybreak, I fled from Hirame's house.
I will come back in the evening.

units.source_text: 我去一下寫在左邊的這位朋友的住處，商量未來去向，切勿擔心，真的。」

en.t: I am going to visit the friend written on the left and discuss where I should go from here, so please do not worry. Truly.
